findings.title: Analytics and marketing storage written before required consent
findings.detail: In the fictional EU scenario, _ga and _fbp are newly written before interaction. Block this consent-dependent activity until the visitor grants consent.
findings.evidence: Empty browser cookie jar before navigation; timestamped jar and collection requests after initial load and repeat run; banner still awaiting a choice.
findings.requirement: Prior consent for non-exempt terminal storage/access under the applicable national implementation of ePrivacy Article 5(3).

findings.title: Sale/sharing opt-out signal not enforced
findings.detail: In the fictional covered California scenario, documented cross-context advertising disclosures continue with GPC enabled. Enforce the opt-out for this activity.
findings.evidence: Sec-GPC: 1 on navigation; navigator.globalPrivacyControl true before tags load; matched identifier-bearing advertising collection requests in GPC and no-GPC captures. Scenario stipulates covered sale/sharing.
findings.requirement: Covered businesses must honour applicable opt-out preference signals for sale/sharing.
